build_segformer_head: build a SegformerHead MLP decode head for semantic segmentation with multi-scale feature fusion
create_segformer_head_instance: create a SegformerHead instance with configurable interpolation mode, MLP normalization, and activation settings
run_segformer_forward: run the SegformerHead forward pass to fuse 4-stage backbone feature maps into a segmentation output
review_segformer_convs: review the SegformerHead convs ModuleList that applies 1x1 convolutions to each input stage feature map
test_segformer_fusion_conv: test the SegformerHead fusion_conv that concatenates and fuses multi-scale features into a single channel output
